items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I hear these guys like -- these different ministers -- Billy Graham and Falwell and another one -- Leroy something.

ctx.x: No. I only considered being a minister. If I had been a minister I could have considered that, which is something. But I hear these guys like -- these different ministers -- Billy Graham and Falwell and another one -- Leroy something. I hear all these guys and there are so many people trying to get so much money off of it, that's what I don't like about it. You can't do it for nothing, you got to get paid for something. But that's the idea. Now I don't want to do it.
I want to go further up a little bit to the point where, I'd like to go to where you're in Germany. Right?
